name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have li := InitStatesLength hi
  have lu := UpdateStatesLength hu
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit li
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  cases InitStatesUpdated hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu
  unfold updatedStates
  refine updatedStatesComm ?_ ▸
    updatedStatesUpdate lu (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  rw [List.unzip_zip li, List.unzip_zip lu]
  intro k hk' hk
  simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne'
    (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx)
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨b, hs, hk, hd, hn, hx⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤)
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hp))
  have hz := hg _
    ((IsTestFunction.mk hd hk).smul_right (contDiff_const (c := f x)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  apply hz.symm.not_lt
  exact (hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right (fun y => by
      by_cases hy : b y = 0
      · exact (mul_eq_zero_of_left hy _).ge
      · exact mul_nonneg (hn (Set.mem_range_self y)).1 (hs (subset_tsupport b hy)).le)
    (mul_ne_zero (hx ▸ one_ne_zero) hp.ne')

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ (2 + 1) A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hEs (j : Fin d) := electricField_apply_contDiff_space
    (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB (j : Fin d) := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
    (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hG := congrArg (fun f => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ j : Fin d, _) x _ = _ at hG
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x)] at hG
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t x),
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hG
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    ext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ =>
      (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
      ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j)]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hG, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀]
  simp only [mul_sub, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, one_mul, mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let f := (LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF)
  rw [map_mul ι]
  change (f ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c) a b =
    (f.compr₂ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c))) a b
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs' =>
    ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs => ?_) a b
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply',
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
    ofListBasis_eq_ofList, f]
  let x := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
    (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs')))
  let y := ι (ofCrAnListF ((List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
    (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))))
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
      x * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * y := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ _ _ _ hl]
    simp only [x, y, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (x * ι c * y)
  · simp only [c, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF,
      List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
      Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
      smul_sub]
    rw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm]
  · rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
      (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc]
    have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
    simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at h0
    rw [← h0, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm]
      exact (Algebra.mul_smul_comm _ _ _).symm
    · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs | tabs =>
    left
    constructor
    exact lc
  case sub => grind only
  case inl | inr =>
    cases lc
    grind only [Value.inl, Value.inr, → Red.inl, → Red.inr]
  all_goals
    right
    try simp only [body_let, body_case] at lc
    cases lc
    grind (gen := 2) only [→ canonical_form_abs, → canonical_form_tabs,
      → canonical_form_sum, cases Value, → Red.abs, → Red.appₗ, → Red.appᵣ,
      → Red.tabs, → Red.tapp, → Red.let_bind,
      → Red.let_body, → Red.case, → Red.case_inl, → Red.case_inr]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case red_I.par ha hb | par.red_I =>
    cases ha
    exact ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par ha hb | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, ha', .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par ha hb | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨a', b', ha', hb', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha' hb) (.par hb' hb), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨a₃, ha₃, ha₃'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨b₃, hb₃, hb₃'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₃ hb₃, .par ha₃' hb₃'⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro hpq
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice hpq, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ _ (h | h) <;> constructor <;> exact h.symm
  · rintro _ _ (h | h) μ u ht
    case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    case choice.choiceR =>
      exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      refine ⟨v, ?_, .bisim hb⟩
      solve_by_elim only [hv, Tr.choiceL]

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hgc⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : C =>
    (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  have hcount := Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn
    (s := Y.toFinset ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (t := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g x)) (fun p => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
      ⟨i, i.isLt.trans (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩ steps
      (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2)
    (fun x hx => ⟨(_, _), Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩,
      (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩)
  simp only [Finset.card_product, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card',
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hcount
  unfold fiberwiseClose fiberwiseDistance at h_fw_dist_lt
  rw [← hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
  have hfw := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hgc) 2)
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ?_))
  refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcount).trans ?_
  rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
  refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw).trans_eq ?_
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]
  dsimp only
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)),
    Nat.add_sub_add_right, ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right]

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f g c Q y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, x] at hq
  have hx : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt, Fin2ToF2,
      get_sDomain_basis, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  have hQ : Q = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * A + Polynomial.C r_chal * B := by
    dsimp only [Q, c, A, B, intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc,
      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  simp only [g, f, fold, P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, hQ, Polynomial.eval_add,
    eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq, Polynomial.eval_C]
  rw [hx]
  ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  refine Nat.le_induction (m := 1) ?_ ?_
  · intro u hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u :=
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    refine hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) ?_
    rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
  · intro n _ ih u hp
    refine CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA _ u e
      (h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow _ _ ?_)
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_)
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩
    · rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simpa only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
        multilinearCombine_recursive_form u, Fin.init_def,
        ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := fun n (k : Fin 4) => (⟨u (n + k), hB _⟩ : Set.Icc B T))
    (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have h (m) : u (i + m) = u (j + m) := Nat.strong_induction_on m fun m ih => by
    by_cases hm : m < 4
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun heq ⟨m, hm⟩)
    · apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      simp (disch := omega) only [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1,
        (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  convert (h (n - i)).symm using 2 <;> omega

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  intro Q hQ hPQ
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have H (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    convert ((hrelation a b).mp h).2 i using 1
    symm
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f h i
  have hd := H d e h.1
  have ht := Finset.dvd_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => hd j)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← congr_fun hdigits_to_num e, ← congr_fun hdigits_to_num d] at ht
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at ht
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    (z := (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1)
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub ht (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)))
    (dvd_add (hd i) (H e f h.2 i)) using 1 <;> ring1
